newsitem.title: USA: Personnel Group of America to issue notes.
newsitem.headline: Personnel Group of America to issue notes.

text.p: Personnel Group of America Inc is planning to issue $100 million of 10-year 144A senior subordinated notes in mid-June via a NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc syndicate, said a high-yield source.

Proceeds from the offering will be used to pay down part of the company's $125 million revolving credit agreement and an additional $10 million line of credit, according to a confidential prospectus for the issue.

After a proposed acquisition of Vital Computer Services International Inc, Personnel Group will have nine companies engaged in information technology and 13 companies in commercial staffing. Its also has a health care services division that operates under the Nursefinders brand.
